title.zh-CN: 受力分析与牛顿动力学实验室
title.en: Force Analysis and Newtonian Dynamics Lab

text.zh-CN: 确定研究对象并绘制只包含作用在该对象上的力的受力图。
text.en: Choose a system and draw a free-body diagram containing only forces acting on it.

text.zh-CN: 用矢量合成和牛顿第二定律预测加速度方向与大小。
text.en: Use vector addition and Newton's second law to predict acceleration direction and magnitude.

text.zh-CN: 通过控制变量实验归纳加速度与合力、质量的关系并解释摩擦影响。
text.en: Use controlled experiments to infer how acceleration depends on net force and mass, including friction effects.

prerequisites.zh-CN: 位移、速度和加速度的矢量表示。
prerequisites.en: Vector representations of displacement, velocity, and acceleration.

prerequisites.zh-CN: 力的图示、矢量分解与合成。
prerequisites.en: Force diagrams and vector decomposition and addition.

text.zh-CN: 认为物体保持运动必须有沿运动方向的合力。
text.en: Believing a net force in the direction of motion is required to maintain motion.

text.zh-CN: 把作用力与反作用力画在同一物体上并相互抵消。
text.en: Drawing an action-reaction pair on the same object and canceling them.

text.zh-CN: 认为支持力在所有情境下都等于重力。
text.en: Assuming the normal force always equals weight.

invariants.zh-CN: 每一帧均满足同一参考系中的矢量关系 ΣF=ma。
invariants.en: Every frame satisfies the vector relation ΣF=ma in one reference frame.

invariants.zh-CN: 牛顿第三定律力对作用于不同物体，不能在单一受力图中抵消。
invariants.en: Third-law pairs act on different bodies and cannot cancel in one free-body diagram.

title.zh-CN: 力与质量的控制变量实验

prompt.zh-CN: 选择研究对象后，只保留真正作用在它上面的力。
prompt.en: After choosing the system, keep only forces that actually act on it.

successEvidence.zh-CN: 力的施力物体、方向和作用对象均正确。
successEvidence.en: Each force has the correct source, direction, and target.

prompt.zh-CN: 运行前预测加速度方向及增大外力后的变化。
prompt.en: Before running, predict the acceleration direction and its change when applied force increases.

successEvidence.zh-CN: 预测与矢量合力及模拟结果一致。
successEvidence.en: The prediction agrees with the vector net force and simulation.

prompt.zh-CN: 依据两组控制变量数据归纳 a、F、m 的关系并说明摩擦造成的偏差。
prompt.en: Use two controlled sweeps to infer the relation among a, F, and m and explain the friction-related deviation.

successEvidence.zh-CN: 结论引用图表数据、控制变量和 ΣF=ma。
successEvidence.en: The conclusion cites graph data, controlled variables, and ΣF=ma.

steps: 用键盘选择物体并完成受力图。
预测加速度后运行、暂停和逐帧检查。
完成力和质量两组控制变量扫描并提交结论。
在两个外部测试站点中重复核心流程。
Select a body and complete its free-body diagram using the keyboard.
Predict acceleration, then run, pause, and inspect frame by frame.
Complete force and mass sweeps and submit a conclusion.
Repeat the core flow in two external test hosts.

accessibility.zh-CN: 所有力矢量都有文本名称、数值和方向描述。
accessibility.en: Every force vector has a text name, value, and direction description.

accessibility.zh-CN: 减少动态效果模式用离散帧和数据表替代连续运动。
accessibility.en: Reduced-motion mode replaces continuous motion with discrete frames and a data table.
